_doc: Kill-switch thresholds (STRATEGY 16.5 adapted by DECISIONS D-C). Every number here is a DESIGN CHOICE, not a measured fact: recalibrate after 8 weeks of real data. Read by scripts/monitor.js.
_network_freeze_comment: true = every site paused (use for a manual action or security issue). Resume is human only.
_manual_comment: Per-site overrides, e.g. { "agenceomra.ma": { "paused": true, "reason": "fact error being fixed" } } or { "multiplier": 0.5 }.

index_proxy._comment: Share of posts aged 14-60 days with at least one Search Console impression in 28 days. It is a lower bound of the index ratio, so it only reports by default.

_seasonal_dips_comment: Date ranges where an impressions drop is expected (e.g. after Eid al-Fitr), as [{ "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD", "sites": ["omra-ramadan.ma"] }]. No crash pause inside them.
